items.problem: External UWP project items with Link metadata were absent from bootstrap output.
items.root_cause: Directory recursion cannot discover project files linked from shared folders. Tier 1 is feasible and stronger than telling agents to reconstruct links manually.
items.change: Resolve common UWP project properties, materialize safe Include/Link items at logical target paths, and include them in namespace rewrite, triage, and mapping.
items.expected_effect: Shared shell code/XAML, scenario XAML, styles, and assets enter the migration map automatically.
items.falsifiable_check: Running bootstrap on NetworkConnectivity copies App.xaml, MainPage.xaml, Styles/Styles.xaml, all three scenario XAML files, and linked assets; .bootstrap-meta.json reports 21 seeded rows and residue scan finds zero Windows.UI.Xaml references.

items.problem: The validator warned on the bootstrap-generated empty deferred table.
items.root_cause: Tier 1 parser logic did not recognize the bootstrap's '(none)' sentinel; prose cannot prevent a deterministic false warning.
items.change: Exclude '(none)' rows when counting deferred entries and when deciding whether the file has content.
items.expected_effect: No-defer migrations receive a clean PASS message instead of a warning.
items.falsifiable_check: A MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md containing only the generated '(none)' row yields '[PASS] No defer rows' and no consistency warning.

items.problem: Common SDK-style migration build diagnostics lacked actionable root-cause guidance.
items.evidence: lessons.json errors_encountered[0..3], skill-defects.json items[2..3], and skill-coverage-gaps.json items[0]
items.root_cause: The correct choice depends on source API semantics, binding requirements, and intended OS support, so Tier 1 automation would be unsafe; a targeted Tier 3 diagnostic table is the highest reliable option.
items.change: Extend existing common-error and project sections for implicit-using CS0104 collisions, WMC0909-led x:Bind cascades, and CA1416/minimum-OS reconciliation.
items.expected_effect: Agents fix the first root error directly and avoid ineffective warning-suppression edits.
items.falsifiable_check: On rerun, the first build has no HttpClient ambiguity or x:DataType cascade, and CA1416 is resolved by project reconciliation without an intermediate unused using or unsupported annotation-only fix.

deferred_to_human: UWP baseline capture remained on the splash screen and exposed no feature controls through UI Automation; this is an evaluation-instrument limitation and must not be addressed in the migration skill.
